description.value:
A synthetic tissue-regeneration compound delivered via dermally-absorbed nanites. Standard issue across the galaxy for both military and civilian use, medi-gel is fast, effective, and requires no medical training to apply.

Activate ◆ (manipulate): Apply medi-gel to yourself or an adjacent willing or unconscious creature. The target regains [[/r 25[healing]]] Hit Points. This healing cannot exceed the target's maximum HP — any excess is lost. Medi-gel does not grant temporary HP.

If applied to a dying creature, the creature is immediately stabilized (their dying value becomes 0) before the healing is applied.

If the applying character owns a Medi-Gel Upgrade, use its higher healing value instead: Upgrade I = [[/r 40[healing]]], II = [[/r 55[healing]]], III = [[/r 70[healing]]], IV = [[/r 85[healing]]].
